ANNOUNCEMENT.icon: dark green megaphone on ivory tile

body_layout.wrapping: Conservative glyph estimates, word wrapping and long token splitting. Reject over limit content rather than clipping.

limitations: Nested lists are not converted into nested Reddit list nodes
Inline emphasis inside semantic headings is not retained
Markdown images are represented by alt text

rendering_rules: Each flair has its own supplied vector composition and exact palette.
Compact mode embeds the body in the SVG and derives frame and canvas height from the final wrapped body line.
Separate body mode renders a fixed 2000 by 600 title only SVG, then places native Reddit rich text below it in the same comment.
The SVG has explicit intrinsic width and height with a matching viewBox so server rasterization is deterministic.
No gradients, raster images, external dependencies, filters, transparency or clipping masks.
All user supplied SVG body text is XML escaped.
External Markdown images are never fetched.

typography.heading_style: heavy italic display text, constrained to each supplied title panel
typography.wrapping_note: Conservative glyph width estimates, not exact font metrics. Preserve a right safety margin and test wide glyphs, punctuation, combining marks and long unbroken tokens.
